source_refs.note: 2. Nutrient Overload (Eutrophication): a main subheading of 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 255-255.

blocks.text: Nutrient overload from water pollution, especially excess nitrogen and phosphorus from fertilizers and sewage, leads to a rapid growth of algae, which block sunlight and reduce oxygen levels in the water. Eutrophication disrupts ecosystems, kills fish and other marine species, and damages water quality.
